scope: Typed Core scene planning, actual guarded Core queues and installed direct routes with isolated policy/adapter fixtures. Ordinary production Core library also compiles. No signed WSS, decoded picture, browser, provider or acceptance qualification in this checkpoint.
implementation: A separate existing-port planning SPI maps exact current direct sources onto one existing compatible confirmed sink per medium. It retains original source and receiver logical IDs separately and never adds ports, changes direction or chooses another codec/format. Multiple compatible sinks or multiple selected sources for one sink refuse.

Source-ID unsubscribe resolves the actual installed Core direct program. A receiver logical ID cannot clear an unrelated selected source. Unknown removals use an owned authorized no-op selection delta; no service routing cache or synthetic receiver ID is introduced.

Existing Core admission, source/member/credential identity, current source and target authorization, route tickets and queued-packet fencing apply at actual delivery. Plans and route metadata are not permission grants.

Audio participant pins remain supported when they fit existing ports. Future non-audio participant/wildcard selectors explicitly refuse in this bounded SPI. The generic native resource-planning API retains its existing behavior. Broader fixed-port/future/video scenarios remain Gate6 work.

verification.repeat_scope: The focused two-method run is repeated within the37-method scene run; it does not raise the distinct count to39.
